question: When CRNN training is restricted to 50 labeled real spectrograms per species, does adding pretrained generated spectrograms improve held-out real classification?
claim_scope: simulated classifier-label scarcity with access to pretrained generators
selection_metric: mean best real-validation macro_f1 across 9 matched blocks; choose the smallest ratio within 0.002 of the best
test_policy: evaluate real-only and one validation-selected ratio per generator
paired_interval: 10000 deterministic bootstrap resamples over 9 matched blocks

training_protocol.initialization: from scratch for every replicate block and condition
training_protocol.input_transform: identical for real and generated training rows: independent p=0.5 frequency mask up to 12 bins and p=0.5 time mask up to 16 frames
training_protocol.selection_metric: best real-validation macro_f1 within each run
